reader.requirement: At --std 85, when an OCCURS ... DEPENDING ON data-name-1 entry is subordinate to an entry carrying GLOBAL (a GLOBAL 01 record, or a record of an FD written GLOBAL), the compiler must refuse a data-name-1 that is not a global name, and refuse one that resolves to an item described in a containing program's Data Division rather than this program's own.
reader.edition-search: Read OdoResolvePass.cs (the DependingAttributeFault call site and body) and DataBinder.Odo.cs; grep for Edition/CobolVersion/DialectLevel/ConstructRegistry/DialectBehavior in OdoResolvePass.cs finds only Edition.Error/Edition.At (diagnostic sinks, no switch). COBOL2788 is an EditionSeverity.Error descriptor with no per-edition arm. The path is one code for every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness pb1261_depending_attributes_and_area exercises only the admitted forms (GLOBAL record with a GLOBAL counter); the refusal half (non-global counter under a GLOBAL record, under a GLOBAL FD, and a container's global counter used by a contained program's GLOBAL table) is exercised only by the probes here

probes.printed: error COBOL2788: OCCURS DEPENDING ON 'NX' on 'TG': the table's record 'G' is global and data-name-1 is not a global name
probes.expected: refusal: data-name-1 must be a global name (SR9)

probes.printed: error COBOL2788: ... the table's record 'R1' is global and data-name-1 is not a global name (FD F GLOBAL, counter in non-global WORKING-STORAGE)
probes.expected: refusal: the record is subordinate to an FD with GLOBAL, so data-name-1 must be global

probes.printed: error COBOL2788: ... data-name-1 'NG' is described in the data division of a containing program
probes.expected: refusal: data-name-1 must reference a data item described in the same Data Division
accepted; qualified global counter N1 OF NG=3 gives G 3 occurrences; the contained program sets N1=2 and sees G as AB
accepted: FD GLOBAL record with an in-record counter; GLOBAL group whose subordinate (level 10) table depends on a GLOBAL 01 counter; G = G1 + 3 occurrences = ABCD

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.8.3 SR9  (5.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR9

reader.notes: The fault is decided by DependingAttributeFault over DataItem.IsGlobalName (the record's own GLOBAL clause or its FD's) and IsDescribedInContainer (an inherited container root). Both halves of SR9 (global name; same Data Division) refuse and the legal forms run with correct ODO extents. The message cites §2023:13.18.38.3 SR18 for the global-name half and adds §1985:VI.5.8.3 SR9 only for the same-Data-Division half (cosmetic).

refuter.evidence: Read OdoResolvePass.cs#DependingAttributeFault and DataItem.cs#IsGlobalName/#IsDescribedInContainer. Probes at --std 85 (runs under refute-1985-236/runs): container GLOBAL FD record counter FN used by a contained program's GLOBAL table -> COBOL2788 'described in the data division of a containing program' (r1_fdctr_nested, correct); GLOBAL FD record table depending on a Linkage counter -> COBOL2788 not global (r1_fd_lk, correct); counter in 01 X REDEFINES H (H GLOBAL, X not) -> COBOL2788 (r1_redef_noglob, correct: only the REDEFINES subject carries the attribute); counter in 01 X REDEFINES H GLOBAL -> accepted, G=ABC with XN=3 (r1_redef_glob, correct); counter HN in the redefined non-global H -> COBOL2788 (r1_redef_glob_hn, correct); WS GLOBAL table depending on a GLOBAL FD record counter -> runs G=AB (r1_fdglob_wsctr); contained program shadowing a container's global NC with its own global NC -> binds its own, G=AB (r1_shadow); class c: 01 LK GLOBAL in Linkage -> COBOL0900 requires COBOL-2002 (r1_lkglobal, correct by X.4.6.3 SR1). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VI.5.8.3 SR9  (5.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR9'; 'OK  §1985:X.4.6.4 GR3  (║4.6.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR3'; 'OK  §1985:X.4.6.3 SR1  (║4.6.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR1'. Residual: the global-name refusal at --std 85 cites only §2023:13.18.38.3 SR18 (cosmetic, already noted by the reader).
